title: Large oriented triple-site definitions and structural formulas
statement: Use the site, sheaf, universe and geometric-morphism conventions of [def-weil-size-convention], [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], [def-weil-pbc-topos], [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], [def-trf-geometric-morphism]. For categories C1,C2,D with independent object universe w and hom universe v, finite limits, and finite-limit-preserving F:D→C1 and G:D→C2, let C be Comma(id(C1×C2), F.prod G). The topology is generated by component covers of types (a),(b) and singleton arrows r with invertible first component and cartesian square of second components and G(r.right). Associated representables are uliftYoneda followed by sheafification into Type(max v w). The first and second functors send U and W to (U,e,e) and (e,e,W), with structural arrows from every triple; the middle triple of V is (FV,V,GV). LargeHasLiftFormula is precisely the specified pullback square of these structural arrows for every compatible cone lift. LargeOrientationFormula is the equality of the inverse-image mate on V^a with etaF, pi1, inverse of the middle-to-first associated arrow, the middle-to-second arrow, pi2 inverse and etaG inverse, including invertibility of that middle-to-first arrow. All constructions are explicit and the formulas contain their actual structural maps.
